name: Short Cut Pepperoni Pizza Stuffed Bell Peppers with Italian Cheese & Olives

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; halve lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop pepperoni. Drain olives. Place both in a medium bowl along with sauce and cheese, then stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oz pepperoni, sliced
1 (2.25 oz) can sliced black olives
½ (14 oz) jar pizza sauce
1 cup shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Turn pepper halves cut-side up and stuff with the pepperoni filling. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until filling is warmed through and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers between plates. Enjoy!
